# Retribution Paladin — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 11/8/32 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 91 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (1 member), level 48 (1 member), level 51 (1 member), level 60 (7 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/paladin/retribution/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD** — 130% of the human spec median (406 vs 312.6 boss DPS over 85 boss fights) (+125 median vs r154) [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [retribution.md](./retribution.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): "Exorcism on Undead and Demons" (leveling.md L144, L261, the 20-29 ret loops). target.creature_type 6 undead, 3 demon; the spell itself allows only those (targetCreatureType 36), 85 mana, 15…

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **PR00u-elemental-stone — Apply Elemental Sharpening Stone:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elemental Sharpening Stone (item 18262, required level 50), sharpening stone (enchant 22756, edged weapons only), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 387); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PR00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 384); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PR00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **PR00u-juju-flurry — Use Juju Flurry:** A haste buff (spell 16322, 60 s item cooldown); the guide names it for this spec; cast on a boss.
- **PR00u-concoction-emerald-mongoose — Use Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 36928 missing (so again after a death).
- **PR00u-concoction-arcane-giant — Use Concoction of the Arcane Giant:** HO-TKB-PLAY-344 (consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable a pioneer can buy gets a use rule so the kit generator carries it from level_min): Concoction of the Arcane Giant (item 47412, required level 50, vendor 2400 copper, DB tkbplay-344.result.txt); paladin/retribution.md L384: damage list (Concoction of the Arcane Giant). Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 36931 missing (so again after a death).
- **PR00u-concoction-dreamwater — Use Concoction of the Dreamwater:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 36934 missing (so again after a death).
- **PR00u-potion-of-quickness — Use Potion of Quickness:** Used in a fight against a boss (the shape of PR00u-juju-flurry): in combat, a hostile boss target, item held and ready, aura 45425 missing.
- **PR01s-sanctity-aura — Sanctity Aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-222 (retribution 11/8/32, Sanctity Aura 1/1 is in the 211 build): "Sanctity Aura (Holy, 11-point sink) is in every Ret build: +10 per cent Holy damage for you and your group", pre-pull "Sanctity Aura (Retribution Aura until you have it)" (retribution.md L17, L129, L195). It replaces Retribution Aura from level 60 (the leveller's build has no Sanctity Aura): PR01 and PR01a carry `not aura_self(20218)`, and the solo Concentration Aura rules (PR01c and the guard below) keep their say: with nobody to heal and under 50 per cent health (or Concentration up under 70) this rule waits, so the two cannot swap each other.
- **PR01c-concentration-aura — Concentration Aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): "Below ~50% health: Concentration Aura, then Holy Light or Flash of Light on yourself, then back to Retribution Aura" (paladin/leveling.md L155; L174: against pushback from mobs hitting you, from 22). PR01 and PR01a hold while it is up in a solo fight under 70 per cent, so the heals that follow are not pushed back; out of combat or at 70 they put Retribution Aura back.
- **PR01-retribution-aura — Retribution Aura:** Free, no duration; holy damage returned to whatever hits the paladin, which is the damage aura for this spec. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PR01a-devotion-aura — Devotion Aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-031 (orchestrator, round-47 delta-0 split): Devotion Aura (465, spellLevel 1, no mana) below the level where Retribution Aura exists. The guide: "Blessing of Might and Devotion Aura before you pull.
- **PR02w-blessing-of-wisdom-self — Blessing of Wisdom:** HO-TKB-PLAY-117 (decision 177): "Blessing of Wisdom on yourself from 14", the fix for Retribution's mana (guide/classes/paladin/leveling.md L112, L257, L264); the party keeps Blessing of Might (PR02), which no longer goes over it.
- **PR02-blessing-of-might — Blessing of Might:** ONE blessing rule on purpose: a paladin holds one blessing per target (SpellEntry.h IsSingleFromSpellSpecificPerTargetPerCaster), so a second blessing rule would replace this one on the same member and the two would alternate. Which blessing: "Blessing of Might/Wisdom" for any spec at 1-30 (synthesis/classes/paladin/leveling.md L83); the archive's solo ret puts Wisdom on himself (leveling.md L112, L257), but a Wisdom rule for everyone would take Might off the bear tank, and per-class blessings need a class on the friendly view or a selector that skips the resident (OQ-2593).
- **PR02s-blessing-of-salvation — Blessing of Salvation:** HO-TKB-PLAY-132 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d): pioneer parties are a warrior or druid tank and a ret paladin, and the DPS threat without Salvation is the likeliest wipe cause data cannot fix; p1-loop v27 HO-P1-LOOP-036): Blessing of Salvation on every member but the paladin itself and the party tank (`target: party_missing_others`), out of combat; it cuts their threat by 30 per cent, which a tank must never carry. One paladin's blessings replace each other on a member, so Might goes on the tank only and this file's own Wisdom stays on the paladin.
- **PR02m-blessing-of-might-self — Blessing of Might:** HO-TKB-PLAY-132: under 14, before Wisdom, Might on the paladin itself ("Blessing of Might and Devotion Aura before you pull", paladin/leveling.md L96), which PR02 gave it on party_missing before it moved to the tank.
- **PR02a-seal-of-wisdom-oom — Seal of Wisdom:** "Out of mana on the last mob: switch to Seal of Wisdom for a few swings instead of drinking" (paladin/leveling.md L262, post-1.18.1). PR03 and PR04 no longer re-seal over it.
- **PR03-seal-of-command — Seal of Command:** From 30 it is the seal, and PR04 goes quiet behind it. NO RE-SEAL ON A MOB ABOUT TO DIE (paladin/leveling.md L260: "Do not re-seal or judge a mob that is about to die").
- **PR03p-seal-of-command-before-the-pull — Seal of Command:** HO-TKB-PLAY-222 (retribution 11/8/32 'AP Ret' takes Seal of Command 1/1, 211 revision 3): the seal before the first swing is the seal the fight uses: "Before the pull: blessings, Sanctity Aura, your seal (SoR or SoC)" and "every auto-attack must land with a seal active" (retribution.md L17, L19, L191, L195). PR03a (below) casts Seal of Righteousness out of combat and PR03 then casts Seal of Command over it as soon as combat starts (PR03 only asks for no Command and no Wisdom), a second seal cast and global at every pull; this rule puts the same Command rank 1 that PR03 casts (HO-TKB-PLAY-122) up first, with PR03a's exclusions.
- **PR03a-seal-before-the-pull — Seal of Righteousness:** HO-TKB-PLAY-031 (orchestrator, round-47 delta-0 split): the seal goes up BEFORE the first swing. The guide: "Keep a seal up ...
- **PR04-seal-of-righteousness — Seal of Righteousness:** The starting-kit seal, 20 mana, 30 s. The second guard is what keeps it from fighting PR03 once Seal of Command is known.
- **PR05-lay-on-hands — Lay on Hands:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PR06-divine-shield — Divine Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PR07-divine-protection — Divine Protection:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PR08-hammer-of-justice — Hammer of Justice:** The interrupt: a 30-mana stun at 10 yd, 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, spent on a cast rather than on cooldown.
- **PR08b-hammer-of-justice-second — Hammer of Justice:** If a second one joins, Hammer of Justice it and kill the first." The existing rule above stuns the kill target when it casts or flees; this one stuns the second mob, 30 mana, 60 s cooldown (so it cannot repeat on a stun-immune mob).
- **PR08a-exorcism — Exorcism:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): "Exorcism on Undead and Demons" (leveling.md L144, L261, the 20-29 ret loops). target.creature_type 6 undead, 3 demon; the spell itself allows only those (targetCreatureType 36), 85 mana, 15 s, 30 yd (rangeIndex 4).
- **PR09-judgement — Judgement:** The rotation's core: free, 10 s recoveryTime, 10 yd, and it consumes the seal, so its real cost is the re-seal above it. mana_pct above 25 stops the loop from judging a seal it cannot afford to replace. HO-TKB-PLAY-021 (owner request, cast audit of rounds 33-34): A SEAL MUST BE UP.
- **PR10h-holy-strike-holy-might — Holy Strike:** Placed above PR10 (Crusader Strike): the strikes share a 6 s cooldown, so on a ready tick this rule takes it when the buff is due and PR10 takes it otherwise (Nazeth's tie-break for Seal of Command, 'keep Holy Might ahead of Zeal', L222). NOT built: Zeal stacks (3) and Zeal's 4 s expiry (L206-L207) need a self-aura stack/time-left predicate that does not exist; Crusader Strike otherwise refreshes Zeal every other strike.
- **PR10-crusader-strike — Crusader Strike:** At the pin Divine Protection (498 rank 1, 5573 rank 2) lays SPELL_AURA_MOD_PACIFY (aura 25) as its first effect, so every melee strike pushed while it is up fails SPELL_FAILED_PACIFIED. In round thirty-four all 22 PACIFIED failures of Rowan (Holy Strike; 22 in round thirty-three too) fell inside the bot's own Divine Protection (r34-cast-audit.txt); with the guard the ladder falls through to what is still castable (Judgement, Flash of Light, the heals below).
- **PR13m-cleanse-must — Cleanse:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **PR11-holy-strike — Holy Strike:** At the pin Divine Protection (498 rank 1, 5573 rank 2) lays SPELL_AURA_MOD_PACIFY (aura 25) as its first effect, so every melee strike pushed while it is up fails SPELL_FAILED_PACIFIED. In round thirty-four all 22 PACIFIED failures of Rowan (Holy Strike; 22 in round thirty-three too) fell inside the bot's own Divine Protection (r34-cast-audit.txt); with the guard the ladder falls through to what is still castable (Judgement, Flash of Light, the heals below).
- **PR11r-repentance-immune-boss — Repentance:** HO-TKB-PLAY-222 (Repentance 1/1 is in both builds): "Repentance on cooldown on bosses that are immune to its stun; free damage is free damage" and the opener "Repentance at 20 yards" (retribution.md L18, L24, L42, L196, L212). Repentance is a 60 s, 60 mana, 20 yd incapacitate (mechanic 14, aura 12, spell 20066; tkbplay-222.result.txt); on an immune target it instead damages the target for each melee attack it makes (spells 51360/51361, 8 per cent of attack power).
- **PR12s-consecration-two-targets — Consecration:** HO-TKB-PLAY-222: "2-3 targets: single-target priority on the Judgement of Wisdom target; add Consecration if mana allows", "Consecration only with spare mana: on 2+ targets" (retribution.md L25, L29, L213, L250).
- **PR13-cleanse — Cleanse:** Item-taught at 30, free at the pin; magic (1), disease (3) and poison (4) in one global. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PR14-purify — Purify:** Item-taught at 6, free, disease and poison only. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PR15-flash-of-light — Flash of Light:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PR16-holy-light — Holy Light:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **PR09-judgement:** (b) is `self.since_cast_ms` of either strike under 3.5 s (the strikes share a 6 s category, so at least 2.5 s are left); (a) 'an auto just landed' needs a swing-timer predicate that does not exist (open question), and re-seal is PR03/PR04 on the next tick.
- **PR10h-holy-strike-holy-might:** NOT built: Zeal stacks (3) and Zeal's 4 s expiry (L206-L207) need a self-aura stack/time-left predicate that does not exist; Crusader Strike otherwise refreshes Zeal every other strike.
